newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-USX-Marathon Group Q2 net shr $0.41.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-USX-Marathon Group Q2 net shr $0.41.

text.p: (Dollars in millions except per share amounts)
Cost of sales (excludes items shown below)
The company said net income adjusted for special items was $158 million, or $0.55 per share, compared to $169 million, or $0.59 per share.
The following notes are an integral part of this financial statement.

1. The statement of operations of the Marathon Group includes the results of operations for the businesses of Marathon Oil Co and certain other subsidiaries of USX and a portion of USX's net financial costs, general and administrative costs and income taxes attributed to the three groups in accordance with USX's accounting and tax allocation policies. This statement should be read in connection with the consolidated statement of operations of USX.

2. When USX acquired Marathon Oil Co in March 1982, crude oil and refined product prices were at historically high levels. USX established a new cost basis for Marathon's inventories by reference to these prices.
